patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose OpenCart only if your buying job matches “GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than OpenCart's shape. Workflow advantage: OpenCart leans shared coverage; Salesforce Commerce Cloud leans wholesale-b2b, catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: OpenCart is GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by secondary sources (confirm live). WooCommerce kee; Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs.
- Company-size focus: OpenCart (small-business, mid-market) vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: OpenCart-leaning — vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud-leaning wholesale-b2b, catalog-management.
- Researched limits: OpenCart — Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet.

Limitations — OpenCart: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Managed cloud floors are not first-party confirmed here — confirm live before budgeting; Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install.

Poor-fit cases: OpenCart is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0 · Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Avoid OpenCart if you actually need Salesforce Commerce Cloud's motion (Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent qu)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
